name: Natsuha & Fuyumi ~When Summer And Winter Meet~
source:
Ishiyama Natsuha reluctantly fills in for a coworker at a mixer, dreading every moment leading up to it, but little does she know she’s about to meet winter early, even though it’s only the start of autumn. After one unexpected night with the Ice Queen of the accounting department, she can’t stop thinking about her, hoping their encounter won’t just be a one-time meeting. Will Natsuha manage to melt the Ice Queen’s heart, or will she end up with frostbite and left out in the cold?

[From [url=https://teamanpim.itch.io/natsuha-and-fuyumi-when-summer-and-winter-meet]Itch.io[/url]]
